craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of containment — the Vijñānavāda opponent staged at full strength, then held; śāstra-hammer couplets, negation-anaphora, terminal doctrine words. Predicate catalogue hammer; end-weight knower — own-forms only address (jñātṛgāmin). Rejected: (a) faces→meets → killed: L3 frozen + faces carries direction. (b) glossing own-form → killed: svarūpa load term, never glossed in song. Read aloud: ap-PEAR-ing, de-SCRIB-ing … THAT-ess-ence FAC-es THE-know-ER.

lines: Appearing, describing — being, and non-being its reverse —
none of it touches own-form. That essence faces the knower.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakhyopākhyā ca sattā yad yad asattā viparyayaḥ naitat svarūpaṃ spṛśati vastuno jñātṛgāmy adaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Do appearing, describing, or being touch a thing's essence? → Essence is knower-facing, never predicate-fixed.
c1_essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).
